jobs.occupation: Business Analyst for F&C Single Risk Target System Landscape (m/f/d)* (Fachinformatiker/in - Daten- und Prozessanalyse)
jobs.description:
Go beyond and create global impact: At Munich Re, we're proud to be one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance, and insurance-related risk solutions. Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.
Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.
With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.
Munich Re's Facultative and Corporate business unit (MR F&C) manages our global facultative reinsurance and direct insurance portfolio across Property, Engineering, Energy, Casualty, Cyber, and New Risk Solutions. Since 2019, MR F&C has grown significantly and invested in innovative initiatives. A robust, end-to-end operating platform with an integrated systems and data landscape, standardized global processes, and a foundation for AI capabilities is central to our strategy. We are seeking a highly motivated Business Analyst to help deliver these ambitions, with a focus on end-to-end support for our global Casualty underwriting teams.
Your Job

- Serve as a business analyst across the full project lifecycle, translating business needs into clear, testable IT requirements and user stories with acceptance criteria.
- Lead and structure requirements engineering activities, including stakeholder interviews, process mapping, data and interface requirements, and non-functional requirements.
- Act as a liaison between business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams; prioritize the backlog, manage scope, and ensure traceability from requirements through testing to release.
- Design and configure prototypes and proof-of-concepts on Microsoft Power Platform, including model-driven and canvas apps, Power Automate flows, Dataverse data models and Copilot Studio AI agents.
- Support the target solution architecture by challenging specifications and ensuring fit to the target process and system landscape.
- Prepare, execute, and document User Acceptance Testing, including test design, defect management, and sign-off, ensuring high-quality delivery at each release.
- Drive standardization of processes and system requirements across lines of business and regions.
- Support change management by preparing stakeholder communications, training content, and enablement sessions for business users and super users.

Your Profile

- University degree or with certificate of secondary education and completed professional formation with focus on Computer science.
- Several years of experience in IT projects with a strong focus on requirements engineering or business analysis; good understanding of the full software development and product lifecycle.
- Proven ability to elicit, analyse, and document business demands and translate them into system designs and user stories that developers can implement.
- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, specifically Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse; ability to build functional prototypes and configure solutions.
- Understanding differences between Power Apps, Logic Apps and Azure Functions and you are comfortable in choosing the right design consideration.
- Basic understanding in documents core pack is beneficial.
- Initial experience with Copilot Studio (formerly Power Virtual Agents), including designing intents, entities, topics, and integrating copilots with Power Platform and Microsoft Teams.
- Initial experience with GitHub for version control and collaboration and familiarity with GitHub Actions or Power Platform Build Tools is a plus.
- Basic knowledge of one or more programming or scripting languages is a plus
- Familiarity with UI and UX principles, data modelling, and process modelling; experience with BPMN or similar notations is beneficial.
- Basic knowledge of designing API-based integrations; experience with custom connectors or Azure integration services is an advantage.
- Experience in (re)insurance, particularly underwriting products, processes, and markets, is a plus.
- Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, make sound decisions, and communicate clearly across cultures and seniority levels.
- Proficiency in agile methods and tools; experience with backlog and test management tools.
- Fluent business English and German are mandatory; additional languages are an asset.
- Willingness to travel internationally as required.

Application Instructions
Please apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. We recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position and Munich Re is of interest to you.
About us
As the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.
Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.
Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.
Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. You can find some examples below.
Unlock your potential

- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: we embrace the power of differences and are convinced that diversity fosters innovation and resilience and enables us to act braver and better.
- Continuous Learning: we believe that continuous learning is a key differentiator and critical for building new skills and accelerating growth.
- Career Mobility: we actively support career mobility, and our strong global and regional presence offers a wealth of career growth opportunities for you.

Rewards & Recognition

- Competitive salary: appropriate compensation for your high level of commitment.
- Retirement provision: state of the art in-house pension solutions.
- Work-life balance: promoting the compatibility of family and work in addition to overall work-life balance.
- Health management: focus on your physical and mental health far beyond legal requirements.
- Hybrid working: living the best of both worlds - we offer you a very flexible approach as well as the opportunity to work from abroad on an occasional basis.
- Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunities employer. Severely disabled candidates will also be prioritized, if equally qualified.

Associate Consultant (m/f/d)
Target Group: Young Professional
Department: Consulting

WHAT WE DO - AND WHY
FEV Consulting is the FEV Group's technology-driven top management consultancy. We act as a guide between strategy development and product realization in today's global environment. We do not simply work for companies, but for our customers - people who want to move society forward. That's why we develop and optimize technical product concepts with our focus on customer benefit, feasibility, sustainability and profitability.

We are looking for committed team players. Together with us and our customers, you will actively shape the future of mobility and the energy industry. You can expect a varied and exciting working day filled with challenging questions to tackle. You will be joining a strong, collaborative team and will benefit from our international and interdisciplinary environment.
You provide support on technical and strategic tasks in interdisciplinary teams of consultants and technical specialists
Your daily tasks include the analysis and evaluation of complex issues
You create management-ready presentations of results
You take over the planning and preparation of expert interviews and workshops and actively participate in them
You support our working students in their personal development

You are interested in innovative products and future technologies and have a passion for sustainable mobility and energy
You have completed your studies at a top university with exceptional achievements and impress us with your personal profile
Ideally, you have already had initial practical experience in management consulting or a technical industry
In addition to your excellent analytical and conceptual skills, you have a high level of creativity
You enjoy working independently on projects and driving them forward as part of a team
You communicate fluently in both English and German and possess intercultural experience
You identify with our company values - customer focus, professionalism, commitment, open-mindedness and respect
An appreciative and contemporary corporate culture
We want to create a positive working environment. In our international teams, you work flexibly on sustainable topics. Through our open feedback culture, you can really help shape the company. We are made up of diverse personalities who love to celebrate our successes together. We work in flat hierarchies and have an open-door policy from student to CEO because we think that rigid hierarchies are yesterday's news. We also give you the freedom to grow personally and professionally. Because we want to actively support you on your career path, we offer a mentoring program for all colleagues.

Diverse career prospects
You can shape your career with us according to your own ideas. We give you the time and space to develop your potential at home or abroad at one of our many locations. Internal and external training opportunities allow you to discover or perfect your strengths.

Work-life balance
We are convinced that only a satisfied team can perform outstanding work. That's why we trust you to contribute to the company in a flexible and self-organized way. We do not have a classic consultant week. A good balance between office and remote work supports you in organizing your professional life and free time in a flexible way.

Additional benefits
With us, you will receive the classic benefits such as 30 days of vacation, capital-forming benefits (i.e. retirement plans), employee discounts and sabbaticals. However, we are constantly expanding these benefits, because appreciation means more to us than just offering the bare minimum.

KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D)

CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

LEARN MORE:

www.joycenterfamily.com [https://www.joycenterfamily.com/]

Are you a last year university student or recent graduate who would like to take his\her first steps within a dynamic clinical research organization? Are you interested in learning fundamental skills to start effectively your career?

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

How will you make an impact?

The 6 month internship in Clinical Operations is designed to offer you the opportunity to develop insight into clinical research, master your skills while conducting meaningful work within the team. The programme framework is crafted to allow you to grow professionally, learning invaluable skills to help you kick start your career!

What you will do?

You will have a mentor who will help you navigate through our organization and processes and receive the best support, which will ensure you are on your way to reaching your goals.

You will need to be in the office three days each week, with flexibility to work from home on the other days.

Being part of the Clinical Operations team, you will be introduced to many diverse parts of the company and to other interns across Europe. You will have a wide portfolio of exciting tasks to complete. Plus test your natural curiosity in providing administrative and technical support to the team proactively, educating yourself about the clinical research industry and master your skills to measure your business progress.

How will you get here?

- You are last year university student looking for an entry level position
- Successfully completed 2nd state examination as part of the pharmacy degree (according to §1 AAppO)
- You have the ability to handle numerous tasks simultaneously
- You enjoy working in a team
- You also have excellent administration and organization skills and the ability to prioritize and time handle various tasks
- Results oriented
- Demonstrate a positive demeanor and desire to succeed
- Exhibits a high degree of flexibility in adapting to a constantly evolving business environment

We understand that you will want to grow both professionally and personally throughout your career, and therefore at PPD clinical research services you will benefit from an award-winning learning and development programme, ensuring you reach your potential.

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. jobs.occupation: Lead Systems Engineer (d/f/m) Ground Support Systems (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Lead Systems Engineer (d/f/m) Ground Support Systems

If you are looking for challenging tasks within a development team at Airbus Defence and Space in Manching and you are interested in systems and software related to military aircrafts, you should apply for a position as Lead Systems Engineer Ground Support Systems in the engineering department A400M Electronic Warfare Ground Support Systems.

We are developing and supporting Ground Support Systems (GSS) for our flying platform A400M in Manching/Germany.

Our GSS products comprise the preparation and evaluation of aircraft mission data, provide interfaces to the airborne systems and support the analysis of the mission execution. The key challenge includes the execution of all operational requirements of our diverse customer base while considering the technical capabilities and constraints of our aircrafts. Our customers expect high performance IT systems and state-of-the-art software applications that make use of the technical capabilities of our aircrafts and allow a safe operation.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead of system engineering activities in the assigned projects
- Define future product developments
- Planning and co-ordination of a development project within the department
- Take over responsibility for the assigned project tasks and manage the agreed scope, time, cost and quality requirements
- Manage project priorities in cooperation with Project Management Organization
- Focus on Customer satisfaction and ensure full compliance with valid rules and regulations
- Lead analysis (Analysis of characteristics and performance) to translate customer requirements, avionics systems requirements into system specifications.
- Planning, coordinating and performing technical reviews according to Airbus processes and provide regular status reports

The female reproductive tract is a highly dynamic system in which tissue mechanics, active forces, and fluid flow interact with cellular and physiological processes. Yet, how these physical properties contribute to reproductive function remains poorly understood.

Within the ERC Starting Grant project REPROMECH – Quantitative Mechanics of the Oviduct: Force, Flow, and the Physiological Operating Point, our group investigates how forces and mechanical properties shape the function of the female reproductive system. We combine approaches from reproductive biology, mechanobiology, and experimental biophysics to quantitatively characterize living tissues across cellular and tissue scales.

The doctoral project will investigate the mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract and their relationship to tissue function.

Tasks

- Quantification of mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract using complementary mechanical measurements and advanced microscopy
- Preparation and culture of ex vivo tissue samples
- Histological characterization of biological samples
- Quantitative image and data analysis
- Critical analysis and interpretation of experimental results

Profile

- Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English are required.

jobs.occupation: Staff Scientist as Parental Leave Replacement (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Single-cell Open Lab at the German Cancer Research Center is seeking, starting in January 2027, a Staff Scientist as Parental Leave Replacement.

The Single-cell Open Lab (scOpenLab) provides state-of-the-art infrastructure and scientific expertise for single-cell sequencing and spatial omics. Our goal is to enable researchers to perform advanced experiments independently: we advise users on experimental design, provide hands-on training, and support them throughout project optimization, experimental implementation, and library preparation.

Our technology portfolio covers a broad range of single-cell and multi-omic approaches, including single-cell RNA, DNA, and chromatin profiling, as well as spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics. Beyond providing access to established technologies, method development is an important part of our work. We continuously evaluate, adapt, and establish emerging single-cell and spatial technologies and develop customized experimental workflows. Examples include HIPSDR-seq for joint single-cell DNA and RNA profiling and the implementation of new spatial omics approaches. The scOpenLab is also closely involved in MultiSpace, the platform for spatial omics within the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim. Through MultiSpace, we collaborate with other technology platforms and research groups to enable multimodal spatial profiling and the integration of spatial transcriptomic, proteomic, and other molecular readouts.

Your Tasks

We are looking for a research scientist to cover a period of parental leave and join our interdisciplinary team. The position combines user support and training with hands-on experimental work and technology development, offering the opportunity to work at the forefront of rapidly evolving single-cell and spatial omics technologies with the following tasks:

- Planning and designing spatially resolved transcriptome and proteomics projects with our users
- Training of new users for spatial and single-cell omics assays
- Optimization and integration of new methods in the lab with a focus on multimodal approaches
- Organizing and driving early access programmes
- Scheduling and maintenance of service infrastructure for image-based spatial transcriptomics

Your Profile

- University degree in life science (MSc), additional PhD preferred
- Experience and very good knowledge of NGS techniques, library preparation, tissue handling, and imaging (skills in data analysis are a plus)
- Previous work in the single-cell field is certainly an advantage
- Very good knowledge of English and German
- Self-motivation and innovative thinking will be required for the successful implementation of your work. This also includes excellent communication and organizational skills.

Please provide both a CV and a cover letter.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Red Teamer/ Pentester Cybersecurity Audit  (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
**Start your cyber career with us!**As part of the global
Cybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals by
providing objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens Managing
Board and Audit Committee. As a business partner to Siemens executive management,
we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to create an impact that
drives change. We offer a vibrant and inclusive environment which ensures a
variety of perspectives and enables big picture thinking.
To deliver on our
vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, we
offer a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe in the concept of
lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where
continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We
invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching,
trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders
on multiple high-profile projects around the world.
Our Cybersecurity team
provides core assurance over the Cybersecurity health of the company which
includes IT and OT infrastructures, product security, software development and
cloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, an
international mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and how
Cybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one of
them?
To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function click here (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf)

What part will you play?

- As valuable member of the assurance team
you will be responsible for conducting and driving Cybersecurity
assessments across the entire Siemens landscape, including products,
services, IT-systems, factories, and software development centers. During
this process you will plan and perform ethical hacking activities, design
attack scenarios for state-of-the-art technologies and highlight important
observations to translate technical findings into management information
so that they can take effective actions.
- Apply advanced hacking principles and red
team methodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat
behaviors faced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud
applications, on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.
- You work closely with cybersecurity
experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling
the root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modern
challenges.
- You independently conduct research on
latest developments in Cybersecurity technologies and threats and
understand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.

What you need to make real what matters

- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree)
in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such as
GIAC GPEN,  OSCP, OSWE, CRTO, CREST, etc. are a plus.
- Good scripting and programming skills and
experience with languages such as Bash, Python,  Powershell, and
C++ / C#.
- 5+ years of professional full-time working
experience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing /
red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.
- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the
latest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuously
challenging environment.
- You have solid experience with one or more
of the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: application
and software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation and
scaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.
- Demonstrated experience in capture the
flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is a
plus.
- Experience with leveraging and integrating
AI into day-to-day work is considered an advantage.
- Fluent in English. German or other languages are a plus.- You demonstrate
an international mindset and are open to international travel, and working in a
diverse team

While
commitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretch
beyond our comfort zone. CF A offers ample of opportunities to seek the
challenge:
Caring for
the world around us is a crucial part of our working culture at CF A for over a
decade.
Everyone at CF A has the possibility to actively engage in our global
CSR community and make an impact with our socially and environmentally motived
CSR projects.
What we offer

- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a future global standard- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Pension plan to ensure financial security - 50+ learning hours per year for both personal and professional growth

Any questions left?

Click here (https://jobs.siemens-info.com/)  if you wish to find out more about Siemens before applying.

As an equal-opportunity employer we
are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/home/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/jobs-ohne-barrieren.html) .

About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.
